---
title: Hosting a local gathering
description: Begin with local relationships, accessible space, and a realistic plan for supporting youth projects.
---

::: {.status}

Hosting approach proposed

:::


A TSP event is intended to adapt to a community’s strengths and capacity. A school room, library space, or other suitable gathering place may be enough. Expensive technology, elaborate competition rules, substantial fundraising, and specialized facilities are not prerequisites.

## Plan for access and follow-through

**Start with relationships.** Talk with teenagers and people who already support them. Let their priorities inform the setting, schedule, and way ideas are shared.

**Choose an accessible format.** Consider transport, physical and sensory access, language, time, food, and participation costs. Provide more than one way to contribute an idea or ask for support.

**Make support tangible.** Invite offers of time, skills, materials, connections, and spaces. If grants are possible, set transparent expectations; do not promise funds that are not secured.

**Agree on local responsibilities.** Confirm safeguarding, consent, supervision, insurance or permissions where required, and a person responsible for responding to concerns. TSP’s alpha materials do not authorize or certify an event.

**Plan beyond the event.** Identify who can help teams take their next step and how progress and setbacks can be discussed without pressuring young people to report only positive stories.

## An adaptable gathering

A community might combine informal conversation, short youth proposals, questions, offers of assistance, and a closing discussion about next steps. This is an example of a proposed format, not a required agenda or a tested recipe.

## Share what you adapt

Describe your setting, the changes you made, what participation required, what support was available, and what you would do differently. Avoid identifying young people in public feedback. [See the community learning process](feedback.qmd).

::: {.note}

**Before announcing an event:** hosting instructions and original TSP materials still need development and review. This site does not list confirmed host communities or an active event application process.

:::
